# ritz.toml / rz.toml specification

Every key a Ritz manifest may contain. The schema in
`projects/ritz/manifest.py` is the source of truth: `rz` and `build.py` load
every manifest through it, so **an unknown key, or a value of the wrong type,
fails the build** as `<file>:<line>: <message>`. Each key lists the code that
reads it; `tools/test_manifest_schema.py` checks those functions really do,
and that every committed manifest validates.

To add a key: add it to the schema with its reader, implement the read,
regenerate this file.

Two manifests exist:

* `ritz.toml`, one per package.
* `rz.toml`, one per workspace (the repository root), read only by `rz`.

## ritz.toml

### Top level

A package manifest: `ritz.toml` at the root of every package.

### `[package]`

Package identity.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries`<br>`projects/ritz/build_pipeline.py build_package`<br>`projects/ritz/resolve.py package_import_namespaces`<br>`rz cmd_list` | Package name. Also its import namespace and, with no [[bin]] or [[lib]], its binary's name. |
| `version` | string |  | `rz cmd_list` | Package version, shown by `rz list`. |
| `description` | string |  | `rz cmd_list` | One line, shown by `rz list`. |
| `sources` | string or string list | `["src"]` | `projects/ritz/resolve.py package_sources` | Source roots, relative to the package. The only place `sources` is read: one at the top level or under [build] is an error. |

### `[build]`

Build settings. `opt-level`, `debug` and `lto` are the base every [profile.*] overrides.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `test_only` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries`<br>`projects/ritz/manifest.py discover_test_files` | The package has tests and no binaries or libraries: `build` skips it, `test` runs it. |
| `opt-level` | integer | `0` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | LLVM optimisation level, 0-3. |
| `debug` | bool | `true` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | Emit debug info. |
| `lto` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | Link-time optimisation. |

### `[profile]`

Per-profile overrides of [build] `opt-level`, `debug` and `lto`. There are two profiles: `--release` selects `release`, anything else `debug`.

### `[profile.debug]`

The default profile.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `opt-level` | integer | `0` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | LLVM optimisation level, 0-3. |
| `debug` | bool | `true` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | Emit debug info. |
| `lto` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | Link-time optimisation. |

### `[profile.release]`

`build` / `test --release`.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `opt-level` | integer | `0` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | LLVM optimisation level, 0-3. |
| `debug` | bool | `true` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | Emit debug info. |
| `lto` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py get_build_profile` | Link-time optimisation. |

### `[dependencies]`

Packages this one imports. Each is put on RITZ_PATH and its dependencies are followed transitively.

Each key is a dependency name (its import namespace); each value a table, described next. A value may also be a string: Shorthand for `{ path = "..." }` with `sources = ["src"]`. Read by `projects/ritz/resolve.py parse_dependencies`.

### `[dependencies.<dependency name (its import namespace)>]`

One dependency: a directory (`path`) or an installed package (`version`), exactly one. A `path` directory holding `ritz-package.toml` is a package too (docs/PACKAGES.md §2).

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | `projects/ritz/resolve.py parse_dependencies` | Package directory, relative to this one. |
| `version` | string |  | `projects/ritz/resolve.py parse_dependencies` | An installed package's exact version: `$RITZ_PACKAGES/<name>/<version>/`, put there by `rz install`. |
| `source_sha256` | string |  | `projects/ritz/resolve.py parse_dependencies` | Pins the package's source tree: its `ritz-package.toml` must record this `source_sha256`. |
| `prebuilt` | bool | `true` | `projects/ritz/resolve.py parse_dependencies` | `false`: compile the package from its shipped source, never link its archive. |
| `sources` | string or string list |  | `projects/ritz/resolve.py parse_dependencies` | The dependency's source roots. Defaults to the `sources` its own ritz.toml declares. |

### `[[lib]]`

A library: every module under `sources`, compiled and archived. A package with [[lib]] and no [[bin]] builds no binary.

One library.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Library name (archived as lib<name>). |
| `sources` | string or string list |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Source roots; a `!path` entry excludes a file. Defaults to the package's `sources`. |

### `[[bin]]`

A binary. With neither [[bin]] nor [[lib]] the package builds one binary named after it, from `main::main` under its sources.

One binary. Its source is `entry`, else `path`, else src/<name>.ritz.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **required** | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Binary name. |
| `entry` | string |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | `"module::function"`: `module` selects the source file under `sources`; `function` is the target's entry fn, which the file must define (a hosted binary's is `main`). |
| `path` | string |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Source file, relative to the package. A non-.ritz path is listed and skipped. |
| `sources` | string or string list |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Source roots for this binary. Defaults to the package's. |
| `freestanding` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | No libc, no runtime. |
| `target` | string | `""` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | LLVM target triple. Empty means the host. |
| `target_os` | string | `""` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Target OS for platform-specific modules (e.g. `harland`, `uefi`). |
| `link_runtime` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Link the Ritz runtime's _start. |

### `[bin.NAME]`

`[bin.NAME]`, where NAME is this entry's `name`: per-binary link and codegen settings.

### `[bin.NAME.linker]`

Linking.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | string |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Linker script, relative to the package. |

### `[bin.NAME.asm]`

Assembly.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | string list |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Assembly files to assemble and link in. |

### `[bin.NAME.flags]`

Code generation.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code-model` | string | `""` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | LLVM code model (e.g. `kernel`). |
| `no-red-zone` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Disable the red zone. |
| `stack-protector` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Pass the compiler `--stack-protector`: every function but a `[[naked]]` one gets LLVM `sspstrong`. The binary must define `__stack_chk_guard` and `__stack_chk_fail`. |
| `pic` | bool | `false` | `projects/ritz/manifest.py plan_binaries` | Position-independent code. |

### `[test]`

Test discovery. `rz test` always runs test/*.ritz, the package's own test_*.ritz and test.sh, plus every module with a `[[test]]` function under src/ and the directories listed here. There is no `[[test]]` array: a test is a `[[test]]` function, not a manifest entry.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sources` | string list |  | `projects/ritz/manifest.py _declared_test_source_files` | Extra directories searched (recursively) for `[[test]]` modules. |

## rz.toml

### Top level

The workspace manifest: `rz.toml` at the repository root, read by `rz`.

### `[workspace]`

The workspace.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | `rz cmd_list` | Workspace name, shown by `rz list`. |
| `version` | string |  | `rz cmd_list` | Workspace version, shown by `rz list`. |
| `description` | string |  | `rz cmd_list` | Shown by `rz list`. |
| `members` | string list |  | `rz discover_projects` | Globs (`**` walks any depth) naming the packages `--all` sweeps. A pattern that matches nothing is an error. |

### `[workspace.exclude]`

Packages under a member pattern that `--all` skips, each with the gate that covers it instead. An empty reason, or an entry that matches no package, is an error.

Each key is a directory, relative to the workspace; each value a string: Why it is excluded, and what covers it. Read by `rz workspace_exclusions`.

### `[build]`

Defaults for `rz build` / `rz test`.

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parallel` | bool | `true` | `rz resolve_jobs` | `false` runs one job at a time. |
| `max_jobs` | integer | `os.cpu_count()` | `rz resolve_jobs` | Worker count when `-j` is not given. |
